cost.methodText: revenue - operating income - cost of revenue

otherWay: Owner cash in the latest 12 months was 6.9% of revenue, above the 3.0% line.
The company paid $856 million to buy back shares over the period.
Operating costs fell from 22.3% of revenue in 2021 to 20.1% in 2025.
shareReason: share count jumps in one year (a stock split, or a conversion at listing); not adjusted
summary: From fiscal 2008 to 2025, CLEAN HARBORS, INC reported $60.1 billion of revenue and $3.1 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $258 million, which leaves $2.9 billion of owner cash: 4.8% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 4 of 18 years.
In the 12 months to 2026-09-30 it was 6.9% of revenue.
